_comment: Reference shape only. The live scene-durations.json is generated per run from the pipeline's measured narration — see README §Scene-duration contract. Copy it, or write it with `python contract.py --from-log ...`. NOTE: 'scenes' here is an array of Manim Scene class NAMES; the Motion Canvas adapter's file of the same name uses an array of {id, duration} objects and the two are not interchangeable.
